claims.summary: The scanner distinguishes exact known model-control markers from quoted, grouped, and relational references while reconstructing a remainder.
claims.disposition: Verified from report-bound source lines 1-400 and the prior complete 1,038-line read at the identical source hash.

claims.summary: Multibyte characters or unsupported surrounding symbols may fail reference-syntax recognition and cause marker removal.
claims.disposition: Verified as two separate boundaries: UTF-8 scalar traversal is byte-exact, while undeclared delimiter pairs intentionally return no reference syntax. Existing regressions prove both behaviors.

claims.summary: The exact grouped pairs ⟦...⟧ and 〚...〛 should preserve an exact marker when they are the nearest non-whitespace characters.
claims.disposition: Exact duplicate of the declared restless-group regression, which covers both pairs and passes in the current 47-test marker suite.

claims.summary: The new relation word mirrors should preserve an exact marker in the reconstructed remainder.
claims.disposition: Preserved as an explicit Tier 5 live provider-output grammar wait. Mirrors is absent from the deliberately finite relation list; this run does not broaden sanitation behavior.

claims.summary: The complete delimiter function should handle context assignment, delimiter depth, and missing nearest characters coherently beyond the report's cutoff.
claims.disposition: Verified by reading the function through completion and by exact depth, whitespace, empty-side, unclosed, and mismatched-delimiter regressions. Missing or mismatched pairs return no reference syntax and remain cleanup candidates.
